scenarios.what: Quote, confirm, driver found, driver arriving
scenarios.expect: One ride at the quoted price; tracking reports the driver arriving with car and plate

scenarios.what: User takes 3 minutes to confirm; the 2-minute fare expires, price unchanged
scenarios.expect: Gets a fresh fare and books without asking again

scenarios.what: Fare expires and the new price is 20% higher
scenarios.expect: Books nothing and asks again with the new price; booking the new quote then works

scenarios.what: Fare expires and the new price is 2% higher (under the 3% and $1 limits)
scenarios.expect: Books, and says the fare refreshed to the new price

scenarios.what: Long Black ride: new price is 2.5% higher but that's over $1
scenarios.expect: Both limits must hold, so it asks again

scenarios.what: Fare expires and the new price is lower
scenarios.expect: Books at the lower price

scenarios.what: Fare looks valid locally but Uber says invalid_fare_id (clock skew)
scenarios.expect: Re-quotes once and books if within approval

scenarios.what: Surge pricing (1.8x) is on
scenarios.expect: Quote says so; booking stops for Uber's own accept step; after accepting, one ride

scenarios.what: Fixed price when quoted, surge starts before the fare refresh
scenarios.expect: Doesn't book; shows the surge price for approval

scenarios.what: Agent passes a lower price than the quote to request_ride
scenarios.expect: Refused, nothing booked

scenarios.what: Agent chains ride_quote straight into request_ride in one turn (seen in VoiceOS: the user said "confirm" about a cancel)
scenarios.expect: Nothing booked; it asks about that price. Booking works once the user has had time to answer

scenarios.what: User says yes, and the agent re-quotes the same ride before booking it
scenarios.expect: Books: the same ride type, places, and price count as already shown

scenarios.what: Agent puts a different destination on the confirmation card than the quote
scenarios.expect: Refused, nothing booked

scenarios.what: request_ride with a quote id that was never issued
scenarios.expect: Asks for a new quote, nothing booked

scenarios.what: User confirms, then confirms the same quote again
scenarios.expect: Second confirm returns the same ride; still one ride

scenarios.what: Two confirmations arrive at the same moment
scenarios.expect: One ride; both report it

scenarios.what: User asks for another ride while one is on the way
scenarios.expect: Points to the existing ride instead of quoting

scenarios.what: Ride booked from quote A; user then confirms an older quote B
scenarios.expect: Doesn't book B; reports the active ride

scenarios.what: Ride completed; agent re-sends the same old confirmation
scenarios.expect: Refuses to reuse the old quote

scenarios.what: Uber creates the ride but the response never arrives
scenarios.expect: Doesn't resend; finds the ride and reports it booked; one ride

scenarios.what: Uber creates the ride, then returns a 500
scenarios.expect: Treats it as unknown, finds the ride, one ride

scenarios.what: Connection drops before Uber gets the booking
scenarios.expect: Checks, finds no ride, says nothing was booked; doesn't retry on its own

scenarios.what: Uber returns 500 without creating anything
scenarios.expect: Says nothing was booked; one booking attempt only

scenarios.what: Booking response lost, and every follow-up check fails too
scenarios.expect: Says it can't tell, and to check the Uber app before trying again

scenarios.what: Price and ride-type lookups hit a 429 and a 503 first
scenarios.expect: Retries reads and quotes normally

scenarios.what: Uber answers 409 retry_request to the booking
scenarios.expect: Checks no ride was created, retries once; one ride

scenarios.what: Booking gets a 429 rate limit
scenarios.expect: A 429 means Uber did nothing: says not booked, no blind retry

scenarios.what: No drivers available
scenarios.expect: Status says no driver was found and nothing was booked

scenarios.what: Driver accepts, then cancels while the user is waiting
scenarios.expect: Tracking reports the cancellation; it doesn't silently rebook

scenarios.what: Driver canceled; the user later asks where their ride is
scenarios.expect: Explains the driver canceled, instead of 'no ride'

scenarios.what: Driver stuck at 'accepted' longer than the tracking window
scenarios.expect: Stops after the window and says so

scenarios.what: User cancels while the driver is on the way
scenarios.expect: Cancels exactly that ride and confirms it

scenarios.what: Cancel is called with an old ride's id while a new ride is active
scenarios.expect: Refuses; the active ride is untouched

scenarios.what: User tries to cancel after the trip started
scenarios.expect: Refuses and explains

scenarios.what: Cancel goes through but the response is lost
scenarios.expect: Retries safely, then confirms the ride is canceled

scenarios.what: Uber rejects the access token mid-booking (401)
scenarios.expect: Renews the sign-in and books, once

scenarios.what: Token rejected and the refresh token was revoked
scenarios.expect: Nothing booked; tells the user to run bun login

scenarios.what: Card has insufficient funds
scenarios.expect: Nothing booked; says to update payment in the Uber app

scenarios.what: Account has no payment method
scenarios.expect: Nothing booked; says to add one in the Uber app

scenarios.what: "Main Street" matches streets in two cities
scenarios.expect: Asks which one; no quote

scenarios.what: Destination is Las Vegas, over Uber's 100-mile limit
scenarios.expect: Explains why it can't quote

scenarios.what: Pickup and destination are both work
scenarios.expect: Says they're the same place

scenarios.what: Address lookup service fails
scenarios.expect: Clear message; suggests home or work

scenarios.what: Agent passes a ride type the user didn't ask for this time ("Black" carried over)
scenarios.expect: Quotes it, plus the default UberX price, so the user chooses; picking UberX books UberX

scenarios.what: User asks for a ride type that doesn't exist there ("helicopter")
scenarios.expect: Lists the ride types that are available

mutants.name: Books a price the user hasn't had time to answer
Re-quoting the same ride restarts the wait, so a real yes is refused
Resends the booking after a timeout instead of checking for the ride
Assumes a timed-out booking failed, without checking
Books any re-quoted price without asking again
Price limits use OR instead of AND (3% OR $1)
Doesn't check the card matches the quote
Confirming the same quote twice books again
Cancels whatever ride is current, ignoring the id it was given
Retries the booking call on 5xx inside the HTTP client
